title: SessionCreateResponseDTO
description: Response of POST /api/v1/sessions (TraigentBackend InteractiveSessionService.create_session typed return; route docstring in src/routes/traigent_session_routes.py create_session). Carries the new session_id and status, plus the experiment's server-issued owning scope (project_id, tenant_id) which the Python and JS SDKs combine with metadata.experiment_id to build the portal link /experiments/view/<experiment_id>?run_id=..&project_id=..&tenant_id=... The legacy route path additionally wraps the payload in success/data and adds message and total_configurations; those keys stay permitted so existing consumers do not break.

project_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free
project_id.description: Server-issued id of the project that owns the experiment (the caller's own context, no customer content). Exists so SDKs can build the portal link, which is scoped by project_id and tenant_id. OPTIONAL: omitted, never null, when the scope is absent; consumers must degrade to a link without it. Present values are non-empty strings.

tenant_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free
tenant_id.description: Server-issued id of the tenant that owns the experiment (the caller's own context, no customer content). Exists so SDKs can build the portal link, which is scoped by project_id and tenant_id. OPTIONAL: omitted, never null, when the scope is absent; consumers must degrade to a link without it. Present values are non-empty strings.

agent_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was opaque_ref; contract has no ref pattern, so the value is not provably content-free
agent_id.description: Backend identifier of the Agent row (agents.id) this session was resolved against, using the SAME resolution the server already performs to persist the session (function_name / agent_key / declared identity) -- not a second lookup. This is NOT the request's `agent_id` (a caller-declared, human-chosen identity string used for cohort grouping -- see the identity contract on this same endpoint) and not `agent_key` (the resolution key); it is the resolved row's own primary key, the value an SDK sends back as the X-Traigent-Agent-Id header when promoting a best config via POST /best-configs and reading GET /best-configs/agent-heads/{agent_id}. Optional and additive: absent on servers that have not yet been updated to resolve and return it, and a caller must not infer identity from its absence.

optimization_strategy.description: Strategy state echoed by the server (algorithm, resolved_sampler, ...).

capabilities.description: Capabilities the Backend supports, advertised so a client can negotiate. `content_less_v1` present = the Backend accepts the content-less shapes. A content-less client that does not find it refuses with `backend_upgrade_required` and never falls back to plaintext. Additive; absent on Backends that predate it.
